entries.name: IOKit

entries.note: Memfd shared memory with fd passing, dma-buf import for the compositor and the plane and colour models carry the buffer job inside the system. Not covered: no app-facing IOSurface type, lookup by ID, purgeability or per-buffer attributes.

entries.name: GCoreFramework
entries.note: Only Info.plist and version.plist were extracted (build 1071.0.1), with no binary or client to show its purpose; left os.

entries.name: GESS
entries.note: Ships Metal kernel libraries (default.metallib with an offscreen renderer and lighting kernels, and mlx.metallib) but no code, so the feature they serve is not identifiable; left os.

entries.name: GPUCompiler
entries.note: Mesa, which BifrOSt ships, compiles the shaders that the GPU drivers run, so shader compilation exists on the Linux side. Not covered: the Metal Shading Language and AIR compiler, and the OpenCL C front end that the reference bundle ships.

entries.name: GPUInfo
entries.note: The Graphics page and the PCI device model read each adapter's vendor, class and driver from sysfs and pci.ids. Not covered: GPU counters, Metal device capability queries, and any SDK API for apps.

entries.name: GPURawCounter
entries.note: Only Info.plist was extracted (com.apple.gpusw.GPURawCounter, version 35), so the clients of its raw GPU counters are not confirmed; left os.

entries.name: GPUSupport
entries.note: Only Info.plist and a code signature were extracted (GPUSupport 24.0.2.0.0), with no binary or symbols to show what it supports; left os.

entries.name: GPUToolsCapture
entries.note: Metal GPU frame capture for the vendor's Xcode GPU debugger (gputrace boundaries and capture transitions in the binary). It is developer tooling of the vendor toolchain, not a daily-driver desktop feature.

entries.name: GPUToolsCaptureCoreAI
entries.note: Only Info.plist-level evidence was extracted. The name points to GPU capture for the CoreAI runtime, but no binary confirms it; left os.

entries.name: GPUToolsCaptureODIE
entries.note: Only the bundle was extracted with no binary or strings, and the name does not identify the capture target; its purpose is undetermined, so it is left os.

entries.name: GPUToolsDeviceServices
entries.note: On-device XPC services of the vendor's GPU debugger (GPUToolsDebugService, GPUToolsReplayService, GPUToolsMLReplayService) for remote Xcode debugging. No daily-driver role on BifrOSt.

entries.name: GPUToolsDiagnostics
entries.note: Metal diagnostics service of the vendor's GPU debugger (com.apple.gputools.diagnostics, GTMTLDiagnosticsService) that reports issues found in captured Metal work. It serves Xcode only.

entries.name: GPUToolsReplay
entries.note: Replays captured Metal frames for the vendor's Xcode GPU debugger; the replay service runs from GPUToolsDeviceServices. Developer tooling only, with no daily-driver role.

entries.name: GPUToolsTransport
entries.note: Transport between the vendor's Xcode GPU debugger and the device under capture (com.apple.gputools.transport). Developer tooling only, with no daily-driver role.

entries.name: GPUWrangler
entries.note: Only Info.plist and version.plist were extracted (8.1.12), and no file names its role, so it is left os.

entries.name: GRDBInternal
entries.note: A private build of the GRDB SQLite toolkit (com.apple.GRDB.GRDBInternal) kept for the vendor's own apps. It is not a system service, and BifrOSt apps keep their own storage.

entries.name: GRDBv7Internal
entries.note: A second private build of the GRDB SQLite toolkit (com.apple.GRDB.GRDBv7Internal) kept for the vendor's own apps. It is not a system service, and BifrOSt apps keep their own storage.

entries.name: GRPCCoreInternal
entries.note: Core of a private gRPC Swift stack for the vendor's own service clients (cloud APIs). BifrOSt runs no such services and its network client is HTTPS in springboard/sdk/src/url.rs.

entries.name: GRPCInProcessTransportInternal
entries.note: In-process transport of the vendor's private gRPC stack, used by its own service clients (cloud APIs). BifrOSt runs no such services, so the transport has no counterpart.

entries.name: GRPCProtobufInternal
entries.note: Protobuf message bindings of the vendor's private gRPC stack, used only by its own service clients (cloud APIs). BifrOSt has no such wire protocol.

entries.name: GRPCURLSessionTransportInternal
entries.note: URLSession transport for the vendor's private gRPC stack (com.apple.GRPCSwiftURLSessionTransportInternal), used by its own service clients. BifrOSt's HTTPS client in springboard/sdk/src/url.rs is the counterpart for ordinary web requests.

entries.name: GameCenterFoundation
entries.note: Shared model for Game Center, the vendor's online player account with friends, achievements and leaderboards. BifrOSt has no such account service, so it has no counterpart.

entries.name: GameCenterOverlayService
entries.note: Service behind the Game Center in-game overlay (com.apple.GameCenterOverlayService). It needs the vendor's online Game Center account, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: GameCenterServerClient
entries.note: Client for the vendor's Game Center servers (com.apple.GameCenterServerClient), which are the vendor's cloud service. BifrOSt runs no such server.

entries.name: GameCenterUI
entries.note: Game Center user interface for leaderboards, achievements and friends (com.apple.GameCenterUI). It depends on the vendor's Game Center account, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: GameCenterUICore
entries.note: Core UI and the GameOverlayViewService XPC service of Game Center (com.apple.GameCenterUICore). It needs the vendor's Game Center account, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: GamePolicy
entries.note: Game Mode policy (its strings cover the Game Mode enabled, paused and disabled notices, a low power suggestion and game controller onboarding). Nothing in BifrOSt favours a running game; build a shell game-mode service that detects a fullscreen game, raises its CPU and GPU share and holds notifications.

entries.name: GamePolicyFoundation
entries.note: Shared model of the Game Mode policy, with the same localized notices as GamePolicy. Build it with the game-mode service in the shell so apps can read whether a game is active.

entries.name: GamePolicyServices
entries.note: Service side of the Game Mode policy that applies it to the running session. Build it into the shell's game-mode service with GamePolicy; nothing applies a game policy today.

entries.name: GameServices
entries.note: Game services client for the vendor's Game Center accounts (com.apple.GameServices, Info.plist only). BifrOSt has no such account or service.

entries.name: GameServicesCore
entries.note: Core of Game Center: its localized strings are Spotlight entries for friends playing and achievements, which come from the vendor's online account. BifrOSt has no such account.

entries.name: GameStoreKit
entries.note: Game store UI of the vendor's store (friend suggestions, challenges, leaderboards and store placements, with an App Intents metadata bundle). It is the vendor's store, not a BifrOSt feature.
